claims.claim: @0xangelfish posted on 2026-11-26 15:07 UTC that Inkling 2 Mini makes gwern's Guardian Angel (a model that continually learns from you daily) reachable for about $100 a month.
Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini on 2026-11-20: a looped MoE with 26.4B total / 3.4B active (5.4B with loops) parameters and a ~20GB footprint.
Tinker lists Inkling 2 Mini training at $0.75 per 1M tokens (64K context) and $1.50 (256K); sampling $0.15 input, $0.50 output; storage $0.10/GB-month; a free 64K tier exists with no stated dates.
Gwern's essay targets over $1,000/month per user, says dynamic evaluation costs over 3x normal usage, and describes a ~1GB corpus on a sub-100B model.
Inkling 2 Mini scores 48.2% DeepSWE v1.1 and 79.0% BrowseComp (vendor-reported) but 63.4% non-hallucination vs 71.4% for Qwen3.8-27B.
LoRA learns less and forgets less than full finetuning; full finetuning learns perturbations of rank 10-100x typical LoRA.
Fine-tuning on unfamiliar facts is learned slower and, once learned, linearly increases hallucination; RAG consistently outperforms unsupervised fine-tuning for knowledge injection.
The LTM-Lab Inkling-2-Mini derivative's own card reports 0/82 work-order executions after autonomous intake and says continual skill learning is unestablished.
